content.text: In Zimbabwe, where the local bank rejected a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creator-built-selling-digital-products-africa-stack|COREMERCH guide to creator]]s-explained-digital-creators|Payment Options]]-solutions-west-africa-broken-here|digital]] creator's request to receive payment from Stripe, a crisis of infrastructure sovereignty emerged. This is not an isolated case: in Venezuela, Ghana, Kenya, and many other countries, payment processing platforms like Stripe and PayPal are restricted or unavailable. Without a trusted payment infrastructure, digital creators are left with a crucial question: how can they build and operate a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, without relying on platforms that may reject or block their transactions?
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Stack 01 — the Sovereign Starter Stack — uses GitHub Pages for storefront hosting, Google Apps Script as the backend Web App, Google Sheets as the order database, Google Drive for product file storage, and Gmail for delivery email. The entire stack costs nothing per month. Google Apps Script runs in response to webhook events from NOWPayments, validates the payment, logs the order to Google Sheets, generates a receipt, and sends a Gmail delivery email with a Google Drive shared link. The daily limits on the free tier are adequate for most creators at the early and growth stages.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Stack 02 — the Edge Commerce Stack — uses Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling, Supabase for order storage, Cloudflare R2 for product file delivery, and Resend for transactional email. The entire stack costs nothing per month up to significant volume thresholds — Cloudflare Workers provides 100,000 requests per day free, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage free, Cloudflare R2 provides 10GB storage and zero egress fees free, and Resend provides 3,000 emails per month free. SPF, DKIM, and DMARC are configured during COREMERCH deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The NOWPayments configuration sequence is the same regardless of which stack you are deploying. Create a NOWPayments account — no KYC required, no document upload, no bank account needed. Navigate to the wallet settings and add the wallet addresses for each cryptocurrency you want to accept. USDT on Tron and Bitcoin are the practical starting point for most creators in restricted markets. Generate an API key from the NOWPayments dashboard. Set the webhook endpoint URL in the NOWPayments IPN settings pointing to your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App. Set the webhook secret key — a string you generate that both NOWPayments and your backend know.
A sovereign digital commerce stack is not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure solution that ensures data sovereignty and scalability.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Testing before promotion is not optional — it is the step that determines whether your store functions correctly under real conditions before real buyers encounter it. The test sequence has four steps. First: deploy the backend and confirm the webhook endpoint returns a valid response to a test HTTP POST. Second: configure the storefront and confirm the checkout displays correctly on desktop and mobile. Third: complete a real mainnet transaction with a small amount of actual crypto. Fourth: check your order database and confirm the order was logged correctly, the delivery email arrived, and the download link works.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Can I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free without relying on platforms that may reject or block transactions? Yes, by leveraging open-source infrastructure tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments, digital creators can deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack and maintain full control over their infrastructure.
Deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack can be done in as little as 4-6 hours with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97).
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

This post is part of a series on building and operating digital stores without relying on payment processing platforms. For more information on deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, visit our Shop URL at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a comprehensive solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours and including end-to-end testing and 5 products loaded.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, take the following steps: deploy GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to host your digital store, configure NOWPayments to receive and verify cryptocurrency transactions, connect your Supabase database to store and manage orders, and test your infrastructure on the mainnet. For a seamless deployment, consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and leveraging our 30-day support.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 is a basic sovereign digital commerce stack that includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, deployed in 4-6 hours. Stack 02 is a more comprehensive stack that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours and including end-to-end testing and 5 products loaded.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages can be used to host digital product stores. However, Cloudflare Pages offers more advanced features and scalability options.
What is the cost of deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack?

The cost of deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack varies depending on the tools and services used. However, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offer comprehensive solutions at an affordable price.
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my Supabase database?
To integrate NOWPayments with your Supabase database, follow the instructions in the Sovereign Blueprint and configure the payment and delivery pipeline.
What is the difference between a sovereign digital commerce stack and a traditional e-commerce platform?

A sovereign digital commerce stack is a cost-effective and scalable solution that allows digital creators to maintain full control over their infrastructure, whereas a traditional e-commerce platform relies on third-party services and may impose restrictions on transactions.
